It is also rewarded to people who contribute to the game, with the primary way of achieving that being reaching 15 contributions in the game, followed by a review by a lead developer.https://trello.com/c/yFpL6Z12/3-%F0%9F%8E%81-reward-war-machine-tower The '''War Machine''' uses an exoskeleton with two miniguns. At Level 2, the exoskeleton also has a missile launcher, allowing it to fire ''Stark Missiles''. At Level 2, it also gains the ability to apply various buffs to towers in its range through its ''Command Aura''. }} ==Strategy== *The '''War Machine''' can be a powerful DPS tower mid to late game, dealing close to 1,000 DPS. *At Level 2, the '''War Machine''' gains a missile launcher, which gains more missiles and stronger stats with upgrades, which is quite decent against hordes of enemies, such as the [[Fallen Hazmat]]. **Because the missile launcher deals splash damage, the '''War Machine''' can also damage [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies with it, making it very useful against the [[Lead]] and [[Elite Lead]]s early on. *At Level 4, the '''War Machine''' gets hidden detection and at Level 5, it gets flying detection, making it a very versatile tower by the mid to late game combined with its high DPS and splash capabilities. **Although it cannot damage them with its main attack, its missiles and the [[Railgun Tank]] collision and explosion damage can also damage [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies. **However, because of how expensive it is to upgrade to Level 4 and 5, it should not be solely relied upon to attack enemies with these attributes. *At Level 5, it gains the [[Freeze Immunity]], making it useful against enemies that mainly freeze towers. ==Trivia== *The '''War Machine's''' appearance and some of its mechanics appear to have been based on an [https://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/615753550626291717/618119104779386888 Exoskeleton] tower suggestion from the Tower Defense Simulator Discord server. **However, the name of the '''War Machine''' and its ''Stark Missile'' are references to the [[wp:War Machine|War Machine]] from ''Marvel''. *The '''War Machine's''' Level 5 ''Command Aura'' description is a reference to its first description, which in turn was a reference to ''Risk of Rain 2'', specifically the [[w:c:riskofrain2:Commando|Commando]]'s old ending phrase. *The '''War Machine''' had the most expensive upgrade cost in the game, until [[Gatling Gun]] was added. *After the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], the '''War Machine''' gained 12 damage on Level 2, giving it 13 damage, thus giving it an absurd 104 DPS for just {{Money|2,900}}. **This was later fixed in May 2021. ==Update History==
